source_title: United Premier Soccer League Names Corgi Insurance Its Official Insurance Partner
source_excerpt:
The partnership provides comprehensive insurance coverage to more than 900 Member Clubs and 37,000 registered participants nationwide.
SAN FRANCISCO , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Corgi Insurance, an AI-native insurance carrier and financial infrastructure company, announced a three-year partnership with the United Premier Soccer League (UPSL), naming Golden by Corgi the league's official insurance and protection partner.
Effective September 30, 2026, the partnership provides insurance coverage for the UPSL, its more than 900 Member Clubs, and approximately 37,000 registered players, coaches, and officials across sanctioned competitions nationwide.
Through Golden, Corgi is bringing its integrated insurance infrastructure to one of the largest club soccer leagues in the United States, simplifying how organizations obtain coverage, manage risk, and handle claims.
Beyond insurance coverage, the partnership is designed to simplify the administrative processes that clubs and league officials navigate throughout the season.
Member Clubs will also have access to the Golden Standard, a safety and risk management resource hub providing expert-backed guidance to help organizations maintain safer playing environments.
"UPSL is one of the largest club soccer platforms in the country, and it deserves a program built for how it actually operates," said Mike T. Brown, Executive Partner at Golden by Corgi. "As a full-stack carrier, we do better when the sport stays safe, so we are with UPSL and its clubs all year, not just at renewal."
The UPSL partnership is the latest in a series of national league and governing body partnerships established by Golden in 2026 as Corgi continues to expand its insurance offerings across new industries.
UPSL Member Clubs can access information about their coverage, request certificates of insurance, and report incidents at premier.upsl.com/insurance .
UPSL is a national professional and semi-professional soccer league with more than 900 Member Clubs and approximately 37,000 registered participants across the United States, including men's, women's, and youth divisions. Learn more at premier.upsl.com.
Golden is a full-stack insurance program for sports and entertainment organizations, backed by Corgi. Golden issues, administers, and services coverage for national governing bodies, leagues, teams, and events under one roof.
